scientific_integrity: Finite CRT residue certificates are exactly reproducible; the proof of infinitely many prime witnesses uses Dirichlet and is not reduced to computation.
scientific_limitations: Only two infinite extremal families for odd squarefree integers with three distinct prime factors; no classification of all equality cases, no claim for composite variable factors, no independent validation, historical priority qualified.
title: Both endpoints of the three-prime totient bound occur infinitely often
